reason: React picks the desktop or the mobile (Sheet) tree on the client from window.innerWidth (useIsMobile) and renders completely different DOM; the server cannot know the viewport, so it renders React's first (desktop) render plus an inert <template> holding the controlled mobile Sheet, and the controller swaps them and moves the single copy of the children. SidebarMenuSkeleton's width is random in the oracle (Math.random). onOpenChange/onClick callbacks have no 1:1 Ruby form (events are always dispatched, listeners are additive).
structure: Sidebar (collapsible offcanvas|icon) renders an inert <template data-chadcn--sidebar-target="mobile"> sibling (no data-slot, no classes) after the desktop [data-slot=sidebar] node, holding Components::V2::Sheet(open: false) > Sheet::Content(data-slot=sidebar, data-mobile=true) whose own host is the display: contents element declared in deviations/sheet.json

on mobile the chadcn--sidebar controller detaches the desktop [data-slot=sidebar] node and moves the server-rendered block nodes into the Sheet content body (and back on desktop) instead of re-rendering them

SidebarMenuSkeleton text width is random in production on both sides (oracle Math.floor(Math.random() * 40) + 50 percent; port rand(40) + 50) but PINNED to 70 percent on the parity pages only: the React harness stubs Math.random = 0.5 and the Phlex parity controller wraps the render in MenuSkeleton.with_pinned_width(70)
api: Sidebar::Provider: chadcn--sidebar:open-change is always dispatched and an uncontrolled Provider always updates; React's 'onOpenChange without open' (state never updates) has no equivalent
Sidebar::Rail: a caller data-action is added to the built-in toggle; React's caller onClick replaces it
Sidebar::Provider: extra informational event chadcn--sidebar:open-mobile-change (React exposes openMobile only via useSidebar)

Sidebar::Provider id: keeps React's meaning (the id of the element) and also seeds the generated ids (the sidebar id); Radix numbers ids with React's useId (unique per tree, no caller control); the port numbers them per request with the Rails engine and per render otherwise (Chadcn::Sequence), and the root takes an explicit base
